scan.completeness_limit: A reproducible full lexical sweep and manual role separation is not a proof that script-only, all language variants, future sources, hidden components or a complete official producer graph are exhausted.

Extra/additive, golden three-times and temporary BG policies are comparisons only; none is a constructed active fixed-round producer.

fixed_round_scope_decision.retained_m5_gap: Fixed frozen-round end-turn producer acceptance, round identity and source-specific policy remain explicitly unimplemented. No times parameter, round field or synthetic-only adapter is added by this audit.
fixed_round_scope_decision.continuous_actual_requests: Each separately reached handler queries the then-current structural pool, draws if nonempty, freezes actual subjects/plans, and creates a new root. CATA_472 under two actual outer Deathrattle executions uses this existing axis, with each draw independent.
fixed_round_scope_decision.single_acceptance_frozen_rounds: A future source, if established, needs an explicit one-acceptance contract for selected carrier/body set/full plans and round count/order. Whether qualification and finite guards re-run per round, whether selection is held or redrawn, and whether max repeats multiply/interleave must be source policy, not inferred from duplicate Effects.
fixed_round_scope_decision.observable_difference: After first work adds, kills, silences, transforms or transfers carriers/sources, consumes a finite trigger or advances RNG, continuous roots may accept different subjects/counts or targets. A frozen round span retains accepted identities; extra execution view may still be fresh. These are different axes.
fixed_round_scope_decision.evidence_priority: First complete public mixed-source composition and recovery contracts using existing family declarations. Pure synthetic fixed-round engineering tests cannot certify a constructed source profile or close the retained source-policy gap.
fixed_round_scope_decision.false_positive_separation: Passive twice/three-times sources, BG golden cards, two attachments on one carrier, multiple ordinary listeners, herald rank upgrades, repeated numeric/stat effects and natural end consumers invoking Battlecries/Deathrattles are not fixed multi-round end-body producers.

public_contract_review_not_implemented.existing_composable_declarations: CardDefinition already has independent battlecry_repeats, deathrattle_repeats, hero_power_repeats and end_turn_repeats tuples. Registry validates each independently, and install_printed installs four AbilityInstance kinds with independent attachment IDs before normal entry events. Static inspection finds no mutual-exclusion rule requiring a new mixed spec or a global shared repetition counter.
public_contract_review_not_implemented.why_no_unified_counter: Four passive attached policies share a carrier lifecycle, not a consume receipt, root identity, timing window, contributor structure or event namespace. A future mixed-source helper may combine declarations but cannot collapse them into one mutable repeat flag.
public_contract_review_not_implemented.typed_profile_boundary: Candidate starting configuration for synthetic public validation is BattlecryRepeatSpec(2) with explicit MINION/WEAPON/HERO kinds; DeathrattleRepeatSpec(2) with explicit MINION/WEAPON/LOCATION, friendly and printed/granted policy; HeroPowerRepeatSpec(2); EndTurnRepeatSpec(2,all). These are local configurations to be tested, not CN rules established by TIME text. Do not silently inherit Deathrattle minion-only defaults for generic Your Deathrattles.
public_contract_review_not_implemented.source_identity: Each family declaration receives its own attachment ID and exact spec. Carrier/source/issuer/controller, primary printed ID, granted/printed provenance and family root/capture IDs remain distinct. TIME family references do not make it a consumer in current/printed end-body queries or a Battlecry/Deathrattle candidate.
public_contract_review_not_implemented.lifecycle: Public acceptance should first prove atomically installed mixed declarations, source removal/silence/transform/dormancy, control transfer, ordinary copies with fresh IDs, bounce/zone reset, and relevant magnetic/composite attachment preservation by existing lifecycle. Any unsupported origin policy stays explicit rather than adapted by card name.

family_boundaries.finite_and_cost: Player finite repeat modifiers retain existing one-acceptance receipt/expiry policy; repeating a body cannot repeat hand cost, play acceptance or finite consumption.

family_boundaries.acceptance_and_positions: Natural deaths use real DeathRecord after shared removal; active triggers do not create death. Only declared self scope survives own removal; no TIME special simultaneous-death retention is inferred.
family_boundaries.finite_and_cost: Timed player repeat sources tick on real owner boundaries; repeat bodies do not add deaths, corpses, Reborn, an extra played card or extra expiry.
family_boundaries.recovery: Complete frozen ability/plan span and first original vs extra fresh contexts must survive same-name bodies, copies and nested choices.

family_boundaries.existing_types: HeroPowerRepeatSpec / HeroPowerRepeatPlan / HeroPowerRecord / HeroPowerPayloadBatch and Capture
family_boundaries.merge: Root-local family max, all retained outcome iterations share the root plan. Result iteration and repeat_index are independent.
family_boundaries.acceptance_and_positions: Keep accepted full on_use bodies, root source/target/parent and original first window; extras use allowed fresh state without reaccepting the root.
family_boundaries.finite_and_cost: Manual cost and one use are consumed once; on_use repeats do not grant additional uses, repeat inspire or fabricate root start/finish events. Indirect/passive failure policies stay unchanged.
family_boundaries.recovery: Root Finish acceptance proof, all retained batches/captures and installed-power identity/HP guard phase rules remain intact.

family_boundaries.merge: Per classified subject family-local max, all/minion filtering based on physical subject kind; PE remains its own carrier even if source was MINION.
family_boundaries.acceptance_and_positions: Natural, direct effect, phase and random-one producer origins stay distinct; selected carrier/body set and plans freeze in their own accepted window.
family_boundaries.finite_and_cost: A finite body consumes once per accepted subject and shares exact real guard Event over its extras; HP guard stays transparent. Repeats never duplicate natural owner clocks, draw, turn event or ordinary listeners.
family_boundaries.recovery: Original Finish state recomputes complete subjects/plans and any producer pool; producer_mode/request/full pool/selection/RNG proof, double ancestry and extra-started phase remain complete.

public_contract_review_not_implemented.cross_axis_rule: A shared mixed source may disappear after one family accepted its plan. That accepted family keeps the frozen source; a later nested other-family acceptance uses its own then-current source window. Never propagate one family count, consume receipt, first-window snapshot or frozen plan to another.

necessary_future_acceptance_checks_not_e: One synthetic shared carrier installs exactly four independently typed policies/IDs before entry reactions. It has no consumer body merely because raw text/reference tags mention four families.

Each of four families under no source, one mixed max2 source, a separate same-family max2 and max3 source: verify 1/2/max3, no accidental 4x multiplication across families and no shared mutable counter.

Accepted first work silences/kills/transforms/removes/transfers the mixed source: accepted extras preserve the original family plan; later nested Battlecry/Deathrattle/HeroPower/EndTurn root captures current owner/source state independently.

Same action cross-family chains, including EndTurn body -> active Deathrattle -> random end producer, Battlecry -> hero power, and hero power -> classified end effect; issuer versus consumer owner and parent namespaces stay distinct.

One shared source copied/bounced/resummoned/zone-reset/transformed: four policies acquire appropriate new IDs or disappear together, old frozen histories remain valid, and control transfer only affects newly accepted plans.

Natural simultaneous death of mixed source and friendly Deathrattle carrier follows existing post-removal policy; source death must not be converted to self-scoped retention from card text. Frozen outer end/BC/HP plan differs from later DR acceptance.

Finite Battlecry player policy consumes its own receipt once, manual hero-power cost/use once, limited EndTurn guard/use once with exact Event and full extras, and real player countdown once. Cross-family repetition does not duplicate any of those axes.

Original first callback/guard windows and fresh extra contexts are checked independently per family, including later source removal, installed HP replacement, dormant triggers, PE expiry and guarded skips.

Pause in each family first and extra position; serialize/clone/restore with a fresh Registry, finish parent/child roots in valid order, and compare native replay. Include whole-span/history/source-plan/pool/RNG/guard tampering, failures after RNG draws and full transaction rollback.
Ordinary and retained Rewind outcomes preserve complete accepted family plans and independent result iteration. A mixed source does not make payload repeat equivalent to multiple root activations.

No new real card is added before synthetic public composition and existing consumer combinations pass. A later necessary TIME_064 adapter only combines proven public declarations and exact metadata/pins; TIME_064e remains independent until explicitly required.
Observation schema excludes mixed contributors, omniscient contexts, guard receipts, RNG and diagnostic IDs; changes to full state never leak to player observations.
limitations: No official lookup, current CN calibration or formal card-pool legality was performed.
TIME_064 raw exists, but current CN availability and source-specific all-carrier/merge/window/hidden component policies remain unverified.
No four-family mixed increment or fixed-round producer implementation/test was executed by this audit.
Conditional/race/dynamic scopes and the complete official source graph remain M5/M0/M6 work.
Full saved raw and declared lexical scan do not prove semantic completeness. BG, CORE, enchantment and story records are comparisons, not automatic adapters.
